files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- 🔖 Support Nextcloud 33
- ⬆️ Update @nextcloud/vue to v9.5
- ⬆️ Update all other dependencies

### Fixed
- 🐛 Fixing the list of podcast subscriptions disappears right after initial loading in case of unkown titles
[#586](https://git.crystalyx.net/Xefir/repod/issues/586) reported by @renbus
